g.text: synvim: In-Line Task Specification, Placement & Execution Sequence
Read model (.puml) & ensure rendered PNG exists
Split window: .puml editor (left) + native Kitty image (right)
Inspect & edit diagram (<C-r> re-render, +/- zoom, h/j/k/l pan, <Tab> cycle)
Floating form: Layer 1 (Action & Ensures) + Layer 2 (Hoare Invariants & Tier)
Enter specifications (or <C-l> prefill, <C-n> enqueue multiple tasks)
submit_form() -> enqueue tasks in Placement Queue
Enter interactive placement workflow (status banner & active hints)
Browse target code via :Find (floating menu) or :History (vertical list)
Anchor immediate sub-task contract in buffer
Task anchored in-tree & displayed in Quickfix agenda (<leader>q)
Scaffolded test file written. Developer writes assertions first!
Stream prompt via jobstart (JSON wire protocol)
Return solution JSON payload {diff, code, contracts}
Attach extmarks & virtual lines (C++20 Myers DTL diff)
Render character-level inline diff directly in active buffer
Apply patch to disk & promote contract header to (status:DONE)
Strip virtual lines & restore original buffer lines
